length(trim(source_geography_key)) > 0 AND year BETWEEN 1000 AND 9999 AND measure IN ('area','yield','production') AND season IN ('annual','winter_spring','summer_autumn','summer_autumn_autumn_winter','main_season') AND statistic_kind IN ('quantity','development_index') AND release_status IN ('provisional','unconfirmed') AND bronze_read_snapshot_id > 0
rules.rule: Approved source-table grain; reporting year, no invented FINAL

rules.sql_expr: (quality_status = 'MISSING' AND value_source IS NULL AND value IS NULL AND ((missing_reason = 'source_null' AND value_raw IS NULL) OR (missing_reason = 'source_blank' AND trim(value_raw) = '') OR (missing_reason = 'source_marker_unspecified' AND trim(value_raw) = '..'))) OR (quality_status = 'NORMALIZED' AND missing_reason IS NULL AND value_source IS NOT NULL AND value_source >= 0 AND value IS NOT NULL)
rules.rule: Retain source missing/zero; no interpolation

rules.sql_expr: ((statistic_kind = 'development_index' AND unit = 'percent' AND conversion_factor = 1) OR (statistic_kind = 'quantity' AND ((measure = 'area' AND unit = 'hectare' AND conversion_factor = 1000) OR (measure = 'production' AND unit = 'tonne' AND conversion_factor = 1000) OR (measure = 'yield' AND unit = 'kg/hectare' AND conversion_factor = 100)))) AND ((missing_reason IS NOT NULL AND value IS NULL) OR value = value_source * conversion_factor) AND ((source_table = 'V06.12.csv' AND unit_raw IS NOT NULL AND unit_status = 'source_header') OR (source_table <> 'V06.12.csv' AND unit_raw IS NULL AND unit_status = 'owner_approved_reference')) AND length(unit_reference)>0 AND length(unit_evidence)>0 AND unit_mapping_version = 'nso-units-20261015.1' AND metadata_version = 'nso-v2-20261015.1'
rules.rule: Owner approved reference conversion; reference is not CSV publication identity

rules.sql_expr: geography_code IS NULL AND boundary_version IS NULL AND geography_level IN ('national','region','province','unknown') AND ((source_table = 'V06.12.csv' AND source_geography_key = '__national_table_scope__' AND geography_raw IS NULL AND geography_status = 'national_scope_metadata') OR (source_table <> 'V06.12.csv' AND geography_raw IS NOT NULL AND source_geography_key = concat('raw:',sha2(encode(geography_raw,'UTF-8'),256)) AND geography_status IN ('candidate_review','unmapped_review')))
rules.rule: Source identity independent of candidates; no historical boundary/codes invented

rules.sql_expr: period_raw RLIKE '^(So b[?] )?[1-9][0-9]{3}$' AND year = try_cast(right(period_raw,4) AS INT) AND ((period_raw LIKE 'So b? %' AND release_status = 'provisional') OR (period_raw NOT LIKE 'So b? %' AND release_status = 'unconfirmed'))
rules.rule: Provisional only with source evidence

rules.sql_expr: review_reason IS NULL
rules.rule: Historical geography candidate requires review

rules.sql_expr: diagnostic_evidence = '[]'
rules.rule: Cross-table/arithmetic discrepancy; keep every measurement unchanged
